  <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="uz">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Ipgo — onlayn bozor</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#F4F6FB;--surface:#fff;--ink:#0F1A33;--muted:#667391;--line:#E3E8F3;--lapis:#2F52F5;--turq:#0E9F98;--ochre:#E8A33D;--on-lapis:#fff;color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0E1526;--surface:#172039;--ink:#E8EDFA;--muted:#9AA7C7;--line:#2A3556;--lapis:#7C9BFF;--turq:#3CCFC6;--ochre:#F0B556;--on-lapis:#0E1526;color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0E1526;--surface:#172039;--ink:#E8EDFA;--muted:#9AA7C7;--line:#2A3556;--lapis:#7C9BFF;--turq:#3CCFC6;--ochre:#F0B556;--on-lapis:#0E1526;color-scheme:dark}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 16px/1.45 "Bricolage Grotesque",system-ui,sans-serif}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--surface);z-index:12}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:11;background:var(--surface);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.bar{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:12px 16px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 14px;align-items:center}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:800;font-size:28px;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--lapis)}
.mark{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,13px);gap:2px}
.mark i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:3px}
.mark i:nth-child(1){background:var(--lapis);border-radius:50% 3px 3px 3px}
.mark i:nth-child(2){background:var(--turq)}
.mark i:nth-child(3){background:var(--ochre)}
.mark i:nth-child(4){background:var(--lapis);border-radius:3px 3px 50% 3px}
.search{flex:1 1 240px;min-width:0}.search input{border-radius:999px;border-color:transparent;padding:12px 18px}
.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-left:auto}#cartBtn{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;margin:0 auto;width:max-content;bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:15;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:14px 22px;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgb(16 24 40/.3)}#cartBtn b{min-width:24px;height:24px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:999px;background:var(--lapis);color:var(--on-lapis);font-size:13px}
input,select{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;width:100%}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--turq);outline-offset:2px}
button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);padding:9px 14px}
button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}button:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.primary{background:var(--lapis);color:var(--on-lapis);border-color:var(--lapis);font-weight:600}
@media (max-width:640px){.actions{order:2}.search{order:3;flex-basis:100%}}
main{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 16px 104px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:6px}
.chip{white-space:nowrap;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 16px;font-weight:600}
.chip[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--lapis);color:var(--on-lapis);border-color:var(--lapis)}
.tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:12px;margin:18px 0 14px}
h1{margin:0;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.meta{color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
.tools select{width:auto}.sels{display:flex;gap:8px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(160px,1fr));gap:12px}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40/.04),0 8px 24px rgb(16 24 40/.06);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.tile{aspect-ratio:4/5;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:64px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--tint) 16%,var(--surface))}
.tile{position:relative;cursor:pointer}.tile img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.cnt{position:absolute;right:8px;bottom:8px;background:rgb(10 15 30/.65);color:#fff;font-size:12px;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:999px}.pay{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}.pay label{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:0;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;color:var(--ink);font-size:16px}.pay input{width:auto}.card-box{background:var(--bg);border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:14px}
.info{padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;flex:1}
.info h3{margin:0;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.price{font-weight:800;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.meta:empty{display:none}.foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:8px}.foot .meta{margin:0}.foot button{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;padding:0;font-size:22px;line-height:1;background:var(--lapis);color:var(--on-lapis);border:0;margin-left:auto}

.empty{grid-column:1/-1;color:var(--muted);padding:32px 0;text-align:center}
.veil{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgb(10 15 30/.5);z-index:20;display:none}
.veil.on{display:block}
.drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:min(380px,100%);background:var(--surface);border-left:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:24px 0 0 24px;z-index:21;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .2s;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
.drawer.on{transform:none}
.dh,.df{padding:16px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.dh h2{margin:0;font-size:20px}
.df{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
.sum{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:800;font-size:18px}
#lines{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:0 16px}
.line{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.line .e{font-size:30px;text-align:center}
.qty{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.qty button{padding:2px 10px}
dialog{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);width:min(420px,calc(100% - 32px));padding:20px}
dialog::backdrop{background:rgb(10 15 30/.5)}
dialog h2{margin:0 0 4px}
label{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 4px}
.row{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:18px}
#err{color:#C0392B;font-size:14px;min-height:20px;margin:8px 0 0}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translate(-50%,20px);background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s;z-index:30;max-width:calc(100% - 32px)}
.toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.drawer,.toast{transition:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header><div class="bar">
  <div class="logo"><span class="mark"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>ipgo</div>
  <div class="search"><input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Mahsulot qidirish" aria-label="Mahsulot qidirish"></div>
  <div class="actions">
    <button id="sellBtn" class="primary">Sotuvchi boʻlish</button>
    <button id="cartBtn">🛒 Savat <b id="n">0</b></button>
  </div>
</div></header>
<main>
  <div class="chips" id="chips"></div>
  <div class="tools">
    <div><h1>Bugungi e’lonlar</h1><div class="meta" id="count"></div></div>
    <div class="sels"><select id="cur" aria-label="Valyuta"><option value="UZS">soʻm</option><option value="USD">$ dollar</option><option value="EUR">€ yevro</option><option value="RUB">₽ rubl</option></select><select id="sort" aria-label="Saralash"><option value="new">Yangilari</option><option value="asc">Arzonlari</option><option value="desc">Qimmatlari</option></select></div>
  </div>
  <div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
  <p class="meta" style="margin-top:16px">≈ belgisi taxminiy narxni bildiradi: u Markaziy bank kursi boʻyicha hisoblanadi. Toʻlov sotuvchi belgilagan asl narxda amalga oshiriladi.</p>
</main>

<div class="veil" id="veil"></div>
<aside class="drawer" id="drawer" aria-label="Savat">
  <div class="dh"><h2>Savat</h2><button id="close">Yopish</button></div>
  <div id="lines"></div>
  <div class="df"><div class="sum"><span>Jami</span><span id="total"></span></div><div class="pay" id="pay"></div><div class="card-box" id="cardbox" hidden></div><button id="order" class="primary">Telegramga yuborish</button></div>
</aside>

<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status"></div>
